answer_1.quote: We provide a short prompt as input to the detoxified LMs and then generate 30 additional tokens.

answer_4.quote: As an extrinsic evaluation, we measure the generation quality of each detoxification method using crowdworkers on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are shown the prompt and asked to select the better of two model-generated continuations: one from the baseline GPT-2 model and one from a randomly selected detoxification technique.
